prompts.stress:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: animation sprite sheet to be sliced into an actual looping GIF for a desktop pet. The attached image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE, not a page to reproduce. Match this specific orange tabby very closely: long broad slightly arched torso, relatively small head tilted sharply to the left, funny asymmetric slanted eyes with black pupils and cream whites, cream muzzle and cream paws, muted flat peach-orange coat, muted ochre tabby stripes, thick hand-drawn rounded charcoal outlines. Four legs and one long tail. Flat 2D Chinese cat meme drawing. NOT a tiny chibi kitten, NOT a round oversized head on a small body, NOT 3D, NOT pixel art, NO shading gradients. No text, no labels, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no speech bubbles.
CRITICAL SPRITE LAYOUT: one 2048x1024 transparent PNG, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows of 8 equally sized 512x512 cells; animation order left-to-right on top row then bottom row. NO drawn cell borders or separators. Exactly ONE complete cat in each cell. Same camera, same apparent cat size, same feet ground line, consistent character model and markings in every frame. Each cat entirely fits inside its own cell with at least 35px transparent padding including tail and whiskers. Truly transparent background (alpha), not a white rectangle or checkerboard. Keep the cream/white eye whites and paws opaque. Frame 8 should match frame 1 to close the loop. The artwork in each cell should be original animation drawings of the same character, not a mere translation of the entire sprite.
Animation: STRESSED CAT / 抵抗代码. Preserve the reference pose: standing on all four feet, long broad arched back, head near left shoulder tilted sideways, tail upright at the right. Frame 1: reference-like suspicious sideways glare, mouth shut. Frame 2: head tilts 5 degrees further, brows pinch. Frame 3: ears flatten a little, cheek and back fur rises, mouth opens a little. Frame 4: mouth opens in a comical tiny growl, back arches slightly higher, tail stiffens. Frame 5: peak bristle and asymmetric suspicious eyes, tail tip flicks. Frame 6: mouth starts closing and shoulders settle slightly. Frame 7: brief squint, tail tip returns. Frame 8: back to frame 1. Subtle but clearly readable hand-drawn changes, planted feet, no whole-body travel, no duplicated limbs.

Animation: CALM GROOMING AFTER A FIGHT / 舔毛回血. Same long-bodied tabby, facing left and resting in a low relaxed seated/crouching pose, keep the body broad and reference-style, hind paws planted and long striped tail curves up at the right. Cat lifts its nearer front paw to its mouth and ACTUALLY LICKS THE FUR ON THAT PAW with a small visible pink tongue; this is feline grooming, not chewing or blowing gum bubbles. Frame 1: raised forepaw in front of muzzle, head down, eyes half closed, tongue retracted. Frame 2: muzzle moves toward paw, eyelids soften. Frame 3: tongue extends toward paw fur. Frame 4: tongue touches paw with a little downward head nod. Frame 5: tongue retracts and head lifts a few pixels. Frame 6: another brief tongue lick onto the same paw. Frame 7: tongue retracts, head returns. Frame 8: match frame 1. Clearly animate the contact of tongue with paw fur, with convincing paw and neck anatomy, no extra arms or paws, no gum, no bubble, no food, no toothbrush. All 8 frames show the same cat staying at the same location and scale.
